application_conditions: Must be an existing Wirex customer with at least one active card; enabled from the account's 'Earn Bitcoin' section.

commission.model_note: 10% of gross fees from referrals in year 1, then 5% for two more years (page elsewhere says 'forever' — inconsistent). Paid in BTC. Referee gets 25% off first plastic card.

rules_note: No publisher programme found; personal referral requires holding the product. No T&C link on the page.

evidence.title: Wirex referral page
evidence.excerpt: 10% of gross fees year 1 then 5% for two years; requires an active card; BTC payouts.

evidence.title: Wirex Affiliate FAQ (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Individuals and businesses welcome; apply via Impact (app.impact.com), approval 'within five business days'; same terms for all affiliates (rates not stated); revenue visible in Impact by the 15th, paid on the 29th; links fail with cookie/GA blockers; 'Offline'/'Other' partner types not accepted.

notes: Personal referral, not a publisher programme: requires David to be a Wirex customer. Decision needed before any use. 2026-11-04: a publisher track exists on Impact (Wirex Affiliate FAQ) besides the personal referral — rates not public; worth a separate programme file once David decides to apply (card published since 2026-11-04).
